create_cb_fcnn_model: create a CBFullyConnectedNetwork model with specified input dimension and hidden layer dimensions
build_cb_fcnn_with_batch_norm: build a CBFullyConnectedNetwork with batch normalization enabled for contextual bandit predictions
run_cb_fcnn_forward: run forward pass on CBFullyConnectedNetwork to get pred_label, pred_sigma, and ucb outputs
review_cb_fcnn_forward: review the CBFullyConnectedNetwork forward method that returns point predictions with zero uncertainty
test_cb_fcnn_ucb_alpha: test CBFullyConnectedNetwork forward pass with non-zero ucb_alpha to verify warning is logged
